title: Simplicity
description: A basic, boring dependency mod needed for all of my mods from here on out. Sorry not sorry!
body:
_**Due to my work on [Spectral's Simple Sabers](https://modrinth.com/mod/spectrals-simple-sabers), I experimented with my very first dependency, and during testing, it worked perfectly. I know having a dependency for a mod is annoying, but please just bear with me here.**_

**This Mod's Use**
As of now, this mod has no use other than being a dependency for my mod [Spectral's Simple Sabers](https://modrinth.com/mod/spectrals-simple-sabers), but it does come with a custom placeholder block for no reason if you wanted that.
Basically, this mod works by holding some info from my other mod and due to this, it's needed in addition to the only mod. (For some reason, the Modrinth moderation system rejected this description because I didn't 'describe it well enough,' so sorry if this seems like a no-brainer.
